measurand_decomposition.measurand: Presence/absence (and relative abundance) of species in a water body
measurand_decomposition.indication: Amplicon sequence read counts per barcode locus

links.name: organism->DNA shedding
aliases: high shedder at low abundance looks like low shedder at high abundance

links.name: shedding->capture
aliases: DNA transport from upstream — species never present at site

links.name: capture->amplification
aliases: primer mismatch suppresses entire taxonomic groups

links.name: reads->taxon assignment
aliases: library gap: present species assigns to wrong taxon or nothing

traceability.highest_break: chain broken at working_standard (lapsed): mock community standards exist but not run every batch

blindness_map.description: Species absent from reference library reads as ABSENT from the water body
blindness_map.consequence: false absences for exactly the rare/undescribed species surveys care most about

blindness_map.description: Low-shedding or ephemeral species produce no signal at sampling time
blindness_map.consequence: presence becomes a lottery of shedding kinetics, not occupancy

blindness_map.description: Upstream transport deposits DNA of species not living at the site
Sampling only open water misses benthic/crevice communities
blindness_map.consequence: community composition skewed toward pelagic taxa

detail.note: unmodelled fidelity loss+bias appears as systematic error
